info.title: Bulkgrid API
info.description: Search the live web, manage and search indexed content under /index, create crawl and extraction runs, and retrieve results. API keys require the scopes listed for each operation. OAuth connections grant MCP and search access only.

post.summary: Start source analysis (may create a crawl run)
Create or subscribe to a source

delete.summary: Delete a source or remove its subscription

get.summary: List source changes for a run
Check source subscription in a workspace

post.summary: Subscribe to an existing public source

get.summary: List workspace GitHub connections and permitted repositories

post.summary: Create or subscribe to a GitHub source

queryMode.description: Run one hybrid search by default. Opt into auto for one additional compact query variant.

sourceIds.description: Restrict results to these source IDs within the existing workspace and collection permissions.

post.summary: Search web pages, images, or news and optionally crawl source pages
post.description: Required permission: search:query (also runs:write when crawl is true).

502.description: Search provider unavailable, timed out, or returned an invalid response

urls.description: List of URLs to extract data from

query.description: Extraction query used to guide the extraction

schema.description: JSON schema defining the structure of data to extract

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for each URL

post.description: Required permission: runs:retry (also search:query for Search runs).

schema.description: Return only missing or dirty rows, plus ordered page IDs.
Row IDs already held by the client.

ids.description: Ordered IDs of the complete page, present in incremental responses.

bearerAuth.description: Bulkgrid API key or OAuth access token. OAuth grants currently allow search:query and mcp:use only.
